model.family: Poisson scores with Dixon-Coles low-score dependence correction
model.targets: closing-price implied goals (90%) blended with scorelines, 60-day half-life, where prices exist; otherwise scorelines with a 365-day half-life
model.optimizer: block Newton, solved to convergence; no pinned reference team
model.calibration: temperature 0.91 and draw shift 0.12 on the model's own 1X2 (0.94/0.09 without prices), fitted on 2023-25 forecasts
model.holdout: 2025-27, 3,330 matches in 8 leagues: 1X2 log loss 0.9873 (previous model 0.9975), tools/accuracy_lab.py
